title: Fish Tikka
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Zarda ka rang (Yellow food color) ¼ tsp or as required
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch (Red chili) crushed ½ tsp or to taste
Safed mirch powder (White pepper powder) ½ tsp
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) ½ tsp

steps.instruction: In bowl,add red chili powder,coriander powder,garam masala powder,cumin seeds,salt,yellow food color,lemon juice,ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein lal mirch powder,dhania powder,garam masala powder,zeera,namak,zarda ka rang,lemon juice aur adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add fish boneless cubes and prepared paste,mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein fish boneless cubes aur tayyar paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 30 minutes kliya matinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Thread lemon slices and marinated fish cubes on skewers.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon slices aur marinated machli ko skewers per laga lein.

steps.instruction: In grill pan,add oil and fry on low flame until done.
steps.romanUrdu: Grill pan mein oil dal dein aur fish ko pak janay tak halki ancch per fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Switch off the flame and give a charcoal smoke for 2 minutes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha bund ker dein aur 2 minutes kliya koyla ka dhuwan dein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add oil,ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein oil aur adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomatoes,mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili crushed,white pepper powder,black pepper powder,coriander powder,cumin seeds and mix well,cook until tomatoes are soft.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch crushed,safed mirch powder,kali mirch powder,dhania powder aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur tamatar naram hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add grilled fish cubes,ginger and green chilies,cover and simmer for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Grilled fish cubes,adrak aur hari mirch dal dein aur dhak ker 2 minutes kliya dum per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with green chili and ginger & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Hari mirch aur adrak sa granish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: A perfectly cooked fish tikka. Try this recipe with and without gravy. You will love it both ways. Let us know how it turns out. #HappyCookingToYou
